(()=>{const original=HTMLInputElement.prototype.click;let picked;HTMLInputElement.prototype.click=function(){if(this.type==='file')picked=this;else original.call(this)};try{document.querySelector('.source-ingest-action').click()}finally{HTMLInputElement.prototype.click=original}if(!picked)throw Error('No file input');const transfer=new DataTransfer();transfer.items.add(new File(['<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="800" height="600" viewBox="0 0 800 600"><rect width="800" height="600" fill="white"/><rect x="80" y="80" width="640" height="420" fill="none" stroke="black" stroke-width="4"/><text x="100" y="140" font-size="30">Archive lifecycle proof</text></svg>'],'archive-proof.svg',{type:'image/svg+xml'}));picked.files=transfer.files;picked.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));return true})()

(async()=>{const job=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('xray:fencing-job:v2'));window.beforeCorruptRestore=JSON.stringify(job);const db=await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const r=indexedDB.open('xray-plan-content-v1',1);r.onsuccess=()=>resolve(r.result);r.onerror=()=>reject(r.error)});await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const tx=db.transaction('documents','readwrite'),s=tx.objectStore('documents'),r=s.getAll();r.onsuccess=()=>{const v=r.result.find(v=>v.name==='archive-proof.svg');if(!v){tx.abort();return}const bytes=v.bytes.slice(0);new Uint8Array(bytes)[0]=0;s.put({...v,bytes})};tx.oncomplete=resolve;tx.onabort=()=>reject(tx.error||Error('Fixture missing'))});db.close();return true})()

(()=>{if(localStorage.getItem('xray:fencing-job:v2')!==window.beforeCorruptRestore)throw Error('Corrupt original changed active project');if(!document.querySelector('.workbench'))throw Error('Unexpected restore reload');return document.querySelector('.backup-restore-review [role=alert]').textContent})()

(async()=>{if(document.querySelector('.restore-review-result'))throw Error('Stale successful review remains visible');const db=await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const r=indexedDB.open('xray-plan-content-v1',1);r.onsuccess=()=>resolve(r.result);r.onerror=()=>reject(r.error)});const first=await new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const r=db.transaction('documents').objectStore('documents').getAll();r.onsuccess=()=>resolve(new Uint8Array(r.result.find(v=>v.name==='archive-proof.svg').bytes)[0]);r.onerror=()=>reject(r.error)});db.close();if(first!==0)throw Error('Conflicting stored bytes were overwritten');return {conflictingOriginalPreserved:true,staleReviewCleared:true}})()
